title: Berlin Opera for First-Time Visitors - Quick Summary
items: **Choose the part of Berlin before the opera house.** Staatsoper is a Mitte evening; Deutsche Oper and Komische Oper at Schillertheater place you in the western half of the city.
**Staatsoper Unter den Linden is at Unter den Linden 7.** It fits naturally after Bebelplatz, Museum Island or a walk along the boulevard, with nearby U5, U6 and bus connections listed by the house.
**Deutsche Oper Berlin is at Bismarckstraße 35.** Treat it as a Charlottenburg or City West evening, with U2 at Deutsche Oper and accessible U2/U7 access at Bismarckstraße nearby.

**Komische Oper's current main venue is Schillertheater at Bismarckstraße 110.** Check the exact production page before leaving because an older guide may still point to the historic Behrenstraße address.
**Use the individual production page for language, surtitles, running time and the exact venue.** The house name alone is not enough for a comfortable booking decision.
Use Berlin Opera House Reader to open the three venue folds before you plan the rest of the evening.
